discovery.type.description: Cluster discovery mode. Set to single-node for standalone operation.

xpack.security.enabled.description: Whether X-Pack security features are enabled.

xpack.security.transport.ssl.enabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled for inter-node transport.

xpack.security.http.ssl.enabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled for the HTTP API.

http.host.description: Network interface for the HTTP API. Set to 0.0.0.0 to accept external connections.

cluster.routing.allocation.disk.threshol.description: Disk-based shard allocation. Disabled by default because the production defaults are too aggressive for what we assume users will be running in Lawn.

ES_JAVA_OPTS.description: JVM options for Elasticsearch. Controls heap memory allocation.
